---
title: Supplementary sections
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'Figure 1: Body square' 'Figure S1: First square' 'Figure S2: Second square' 'Table S1: A table' 'S1 First supplement' 'S1.1 Sub-section' 'S2 Second supplement' 'Theorem S1' 'Note S1' 'See S1 and S1.1' 'See Figure S2 and Theorem S1'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
          printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE "1 Body.*S1 First supplement.*S2 Second supplement" || { echo "wrong order"; exit 1; }
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---
